decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed demolition of the existing conservatory, erection of a porch, single storey part side and rear extension and conversion of garage to a habitable room because of their position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 869 Great West Road and complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with the adopted UDP policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.
Condition : 5 - The extensions  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 869 Great West Road.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing conservatory and erection of single storey part side and rear extension and conversion of garage to habitable room to dwellinghouse.
